component.name: GEstimator
component.summary: Cost estimates with rate analysis for civil and electrical works

description.p: GEstimator prepares cost and quantity estimates of civil and electrical works with detailed rate analysis. It comes with DSR 2023 (Civil), DSR (E and M) 2025 and DSR 2025 (Horticulture and Landscaping) and can use other databases of items.

ul.li: Schedule of items, resources and details of measurements in tables with keyboard navigation
Rate analysis editor with undo, bulk editing of analyses and rate updates from databases
Several projects open in tabs, with recovery of unsaved work
Import from and export to Excel workbooks
Optional local MCP server for AI assistants to read and prepare estimates

screenshot.caption: Schedule of an estimate priced from DSR 2023
Rate analysis of a schedule item
Adding items from a bundled database

ul.li: Snap: fix start failure "libEGL fatal: did not find extension DRI_Mesa version 1" on systems with newer graphics drivers
Flatpak: fix the window not opening on systems with WOFF fonts installed (such as fonts-ebgaramond-extra)

description.p: New desktop application with a redesigned interface.

ul.li: Ribbon commands, light and dark themes, project tabs with recovery of unsaved work
Bundled DSR 2023 (Civil), DSR (E and M) 2025 with Correction Slip No. 1 and DSR 2025 (Horticulture and Landscaping), each with database notes
Type-ahead search when adding items from a database
Bulk analysis editing, mapped Excel imports and local MCP server for AI assistants
User manual with screenshots
Support for modifying schedule rate while adding item
Update to DSR E and M 2022 as per ammendments issued, modification in GST, LC
